evidence.mission_note: A GX470 with a quality lift, all-terrains, rack and awning directly supplies body-on-frame camping capability the RX 350 lacks, so it fits the utility_capability branch. At 249k its fit depends entirely on documented renewal and a clean frame.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a lifted, overland-equipped 2006 GX470 at a claimed 249,000 miles, with photos confirming the V8, OME-style front suspension, four matching BFG all-terrains and a straight body. Observed negatives are rear bumper paint damage, oxidised headlights, surface scale on the front frame of a coastal Georgia car, and a set of aftermarket electrical add-ons of unknown installation quality. The highest-value claims (transmission rebuilt last year, timing belt and water pump about two years ago, new steering rack and tie rods) are seller sentences with no invoices, dates or mileages. There is no VIN, so title, accident and owner history cannot be checked. Radiator status, the reason for the auxiliary fan, warning-light state after the air-bag delete, and rear frame condition remain open. At $13,000 the asking price sits above the $10,630 fair-value mid, and sold comps near this mileage closed at $8,400-$9,000.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller for the VIN, the transmission-rebuild and timing-belt invoices, full-frame underside photos and tire date codes, and confirm a local independent PPI is allowed before any deposit.
